claims.claim: Okta's Q2 FY2027 revenue reached $805 million, up 11% year over year, while RPO grew 17% and cRPO grew 14%.
Management said new-product contributions were led by Okta Identity Governance and framed AI-agent identity as a growing security control problem.
Okta scheduled its Oktane opening keynote and Investor Summit for September 23, 2026, providing a near-term product/strategy checkpoint.

factors.name: identity-security demand
factors.basis: RPO/cRPO growth and new-product contribution indicate continuing demand beyond the legacy core.

factors.name: agentic-AI security adjacency
factors.basis: Okta is extending identity controls to AI agents, an emerging non-human identity surface.

risks.risk: AI-agent security is an emerging market; category importance does not establish Okta's eventual share or monetization.

unknowns.unknown: September 23 product/strategy disclosures are not yet available and must not be inferred.

claims.claim: Q2 FY2027 GAAP operating income was $107 million, or 13% of revenue, versus $41 million/6% a year earlier; operating cash flow was $234 million and free cash flow $227 million.
Revenue growth remained 11%, while cRPO growth accelerated to 14%, providing a forward subscription-demand signal that should be tested against subsequent conversion.

factors.name: profitability conversion
factors.basis: Higher GAAP operating margin and cash flow show improving economic execution alongside growth.

factors.name: forward demand conversion
factors.basis: cRPO growth above current revenue growth suggests contracted near-term subscription demand, subject to normal recognition/conversion risks.

risks.risk: Large-platform competition and customer optimization can pressure growth even with improving margins.

unknowns.unknown: No security-level valuation conclusion is asserted by Scout.
